title: PRISM — P: People & Place
description: Defines who is involved in the enterprise and from where they operate. Covers stakeholders, geographies, and operating environments.

schema_version.description: PRISM schema version this artifact targets (e.g., '1.1').

temporal_state.description: The point-in-time status of this artifact.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date when this artifact reflects reality (baseline) or is targeted (target).

label.description: Human-readable label for this artifact, e.g. 'Baseline Q1 2025'.

stakeholders.description: Roles, personas, organizational units, and external parties involved in the enterprise.

id.description: Unique identifier for this stakeholder (slug format recommended, e.g. 'cto', 'end-user-emea').

role.description: Functional role or title (e.g., 'Chief Technology Officer', 'Clinical Nurse', 'Line Operator').

type.description: Classification of the stakeholder's relationship to the enterprise.

org_unit.description: Organizational unit, department, or team this stakeholder belongs to.

geography_ids.description: References to geography IDs where this stakeholder operates.

concerns.description: Key architectural concerns this stakeholder holds (e.g., 'uptime', 'data privacy', 'cost').

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling (e.g., 'executive', 'data-owner', 'external-regulator').

notes.description: Free-text notes about this stakeholder's context or influence.

geographies.description: Physical locations, regions, regulatory jurisdictions, cloud regions, and logical environments.

type.description: Geographic granularity. cloud-region, data-center, and availability-zone support cloud and infrastructure topology modeling.

regulatory_zone.description: Regulatory or legal jurisdiction (e.g., 'GDPR', 'HIPAA', 'FDA 21 CFR Part 11'). For structured compliance coverage use compliance_frameworks on Reality artifacts.

cloud_provider.description: Cloud provider for cloud-region, data-center, and availability-zone type geographies.

parent_id.description: Reference to a parent geography ID to express containment hierarchy (e.g., an availability-zone inside a cloud-region).

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling (e.g., 'primary', 'dr-site', 'regulated').

environments.description: Operating contexts in which the enterprise runs. Environments are distinct from geographies — the same environment type can exist in multiple locations.

type.description: Environment classification. 'qa' = quality assurance. 'pre-production' = final gate before production. 'performance' = load and stress testing. Use 'tier' for custom labels beyond this classification.

tier.description: Free-form tier label for organizations with custom environment naming conventions (e.g., 'tier-1', 'prod-eu', 'uat-2', 'green'). Supplements the type classification.

geography_id.description: Reference to the geography ID where this environment operates.

owner_stakeholder_id.description: Reference to the stakeholder ID responsible for this environment.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling (e.g., 'critical', 'regulated', 'short-lived').
